Good — this is the reconciliation step: given the same deterministic schedule, I'll trace every *client op → retry → offset*, every *message → delivery outcome*, and every *replica → offset adjustment*, then check that they add up.

Key instrumentation: each op carries a stable `req_id` across attempts, each replica has a `seen` idempotency table, and every message is logged with send/deliver times and status.

```python
import pandas as pd
pd.set_option("display.width", 260)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", 60)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 300)

N, QUORUM = 5, 3
canonical, DELAYS = [], []
attempts, messages, offset_events, elections = [], [], [], []
KEYS = ("offset", "req_id", "value", "epoch", "leader")

class Node:
    def __init__(self, rid):
        self.rid = rid; self.up = True; self.group = 1; self.epoch = 0
        self.role = "follower"; self.leader = None
        self.log = []; self.commit_index = 0; self.applied_index = 0
        self.seen = {}                      # req_id -> offset   (idempotency table)
    @property
    def last_index(self): return len(self.log)

nodes = {f"r{i}": Node(f"r{i}") for i in range(N)}
def canon(e): return {k: e[k] for k in KEYS}
def can_talk(a, b):
    return nodes[a].up and nodes[b].up and nodes[a].group == nodes[b].group
def delay_between(a, b, t):
    return max([ms for fa, fb, ms, until in DELAYS if fa == a and fb == b and t <= until] or [0])
def leader_in_group(g):
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if n.up and n.group == g and n.role == "leader": return rid
    return None
def elect(cand, epoch, t):
    c = nodes[cand]; c.epoch = epoch; votes = [cand]
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if rid == cand or not n.up or n.group != c.group: continue
        if n.epoch <= epoch: n.epoch = epoch; votes.append(rid)
    won = len(votes) >= QUORUM
    if won:
        for rid, n in nodes.items():
            if n.up and n.group == c.group: n.role, n.leader = "follower", cand
        c.role = "leader"
    elections.append(dict(t=t, epoch=epoch, candidate=cand, votes=len(votes), quorum=QUORUM,
                          result="WON" if won else "LOST"))
    return cand if won else None

def submit(op, req_id, value, attempt_no, t, via):
    g = nodes[via].group; lid = leader_in_group(g)
    if lid is None:
        attempts.append(dict(op=op, req_id=req_id, attempt=attempt_no, t=t, via=via, group=g,
                             leader=None, outcome="REFUSED:no-leader", offset=None, acks=0,
                             commit_t=None, latency_ms=None, dedup=False, note=""))
        return None
    L = nodes[lid]
    if req_id in L.seen:                                   # ---- idempotency hit ----
        off = L.seen[req_id]
        attempts.append(dict(op=op, req_id=req_id, attempt=attempt_no, t=t, via=via, group=g,
                             leader=lid, outcome="DEDUP:returns-existing", offset=off, acks=0,
                             commit_t=None, latency_ms=None, dedup=True,
                             note=f"no new entry; offset {off} reused"))
        return off
    off = L.last_index + 1
    entry = dict(offset=off, req_id=req_id, value=value, epoch=L.epoch, leader=lid)
    L.log.append(entry); L.seen[req_id] = off
    ack_times = {lid: t}
    for rid, n in nodes.items():
        if rid == lid: continue
        if not can_talk(lid, rid):
            messages.append(dict(t_send=t, frm=lid, to=rid, type="append_entries", offset=off,
                                 status="DROPPED", t_deliver=None, note="no path (down/partitioned)"))
            continue
        d = delay_between(lid, rid, t); tdel = t + d
        n.log.append(entry); n.seen[req_id] = off; ack_times[rid] = tdel
        messages.append(dict(t_send=t, frm=lid, to=rid, type="append_entries", offset=off,
                             status="DELAYED" if d else "DELIVERED", t_deliver=tdel,
                             note=f"+{d:.0f} ms" if d else ""))
        messages.append(dict(t_send=tdel, frm=rid, to=lid, type="append_ack", offset=off,
                             status="DELIVERED", t_deliver=tdel, note="ack"))
    if len(ack_times) >= QUORUM:
        ctime = sorted(ack_times.values())[QUORUM - 1]
        for rid in ack_times:
            nodes[rid].commit_index = off; nodes[rid].applied_index = off
        canonical.append(dict(entry, commit_t=ctime))
        outcome, ct, lat = "committed", ctime, ctime - t
    else:
        outcome, ct, lat = "REFUSED:no-quorum", None, None
    attempts.append(dict(op=op, req_id=req_id, attempt=attempt_no, t=t, via=via, group=g,
                         leader=lid, outcome=outcome,
                         offset=off if outcome == "committed" else None,
                         acks=len(ack_times), commit_t=ct, latency_ms=lat, dedup=False,
                         note="" if outcome == "committed" else "entry held, uncommitted"))
    return off if outcome == "committed" else None

def resync(rid, t, phase):
    n = nodes[rid]; before = n.last_index; rewound = 0
    for e in canonical:
        cur = canon(e)
        if e["offset"] > n.last_index:
            n.log.append(cur); n.seen[e["req_id"]] = e["offset"]
        elif n.log[e["offset"] - 1] != cur:
            n.log = n.log[: e["offset"] - 1]; n.log.append(cur); rewound += 1
    n.commit_index = len(canonical); n.applied_index = len(canonical)
    offset_events.append(dict(t=t, replica=f"r{rid}", phase=phase, offset_before=before,
                              offset_after=n.last_index, delta=n.last_index - before,
                              action="catch-up" if n.last_index > before else "no-change",
                              rewound_entries=rewound))

# =========================== deterministic run ===========================
elect("r0", 1, 100)
submit("op-1", "req-1", "v1", 1, 100, "r0")
submit("op-2", "req-2", "v2", 1, 200, "r0")

nodes["r0"].up = False; nodes["r0"].role = "follower"        # LEADER CRASH @300
submit("op-3", "req-3", "v3", 1, 320, "r0")
submit("op-4", "req-4", "v4", 1, 350, "r0")
offset_events.append(dict(t=300, replica="r0", phase="leader-crash", offset_before=2,
                          offset_after=2, delta=0, action="no-change", rewound_entries=0))

elect("r3", 2, 400)                                          # ELECTION @400
submit("op-3", "req-3", "v3", 2, 420, "r3")                  # RETRY
submit("op-4", "req-4", "v4", 2, 440, "r3")                  # RETRY

nodes["r4"].up = False                                       # FOLLOWER CRASH @550
DELAYS.append(("r3", "r1", 150, 720))                        # DELAYED MSG r3->r1
submit("op-5", "req-5", "v5", 1, 550, "r3")                  # commits at 700 (+150 ms)
submit("op-5", "req-5", "v5", 2, 560, "r3")                  # client timeout RETRY -> DEDUP

nodes["r0"].up = True; nodes["r4"].up = True                 # RECOVER @750
resync("r0", 750, "recover-after-leader-crash")
resync("r4", 750, "recover-after-follower-crash")

for n in nodes.values(): n.group = 1                         # PARTITION @800
for rid in ("r1", "r3", "r4"): nodes[rid].group = 1
for rid in ("r0", "r2"): nodes[rid].group = 2
submit("op-6", "req-6", "v6", 1, 850, "r3")                  # majority OK
submit("op-7", "req-7", "v7", 1, 880, "r0")                  # minority refused
submit("op-8", "req-8", "v8", 1, 900, "r2")                  # minority refused

for n in nodes.values(): n.group = 1                         # HEAL @950
for rid in nodes: resync(rid, 950, "heal-partition")
submit("op-7", "req-7", "v7", 2, 960, "r3")                  # RETRY
submit("op-8", "req-8", "v8", 2, 980, "r3")                  # RETRY

# =========================== reconciliation ===========================
att = pd.DataFrame(attempts)
retry = (att.groupby(["op", "req_id"])
          .agg(attempts_n=("attempt", "count"),
               first_outcome=("outcome", "first"),
               final_outcome=("outcome", "last"),
               offsets_claimed=("offset", lambda s: sorted(set(s.dropna()))),
               dedup_hits=("dedup", "sum"),
               first_t=("t", "min"), last_t=("t", "max"))
          .reset_index())
retry["retried"] = retry.attempts_n > 1
retry["offsets_assigned"] = retry.offsets_claimed.apply(len)
retry["exactly_one_offset"] = retry.offsets_assigned.eq(1)
retry["final_offset"] = retry.offsets_claimed.apply(lambda l: l[0] if l else None)

msg = pd.DataFrame(messages)
deliv = (msg.groupby(["type", "status"]).size().rename("messages")
            .reset_index())

offrec = pd.DataFrame(offset_events)

print("=== 1. ATTEMPT LEDGER (every submit, in order) ===")
display(att[["op", "req_id", "attempt", "t", "via", "group", "leader", "outcome",
             "offset", "acks", "commit_t", "latency_ms", "dedup", "note"]])

print("\n=== 2. RETRY RECONCILIATION (per client operation) ===")
display(retry[["op", "req_id", "attempts_n", "retried", "first_outcome", "final_outcome",
               "offsets_claimed", "dedup_hits", "exactly_one_offset", "first_t", "last_t"]])

print("\n=== 3. MESSAGE DELIVERY LEDGER ===")
display(msg)

print("\n=== 4. DELIVERY RECONCILIATION (counts) ===")
display(deliv)

print("\n=== 5. OFFSET RECONCILIATION (per replica per fault boundary) ===")
display(offrec)

print("\n=== 6. FINAL OFFSET MAP ===")
fmap = retry.sort_values("final_offset")[["op", "req_id", "attempts_n", "final_offset"]]
display(fmap)
bijective = (fmap.final_offset.notna().all()
             and len(set(fmap.final_offset)) == len(fmap) == len(canonical))
contiguous = sorted(fmap.final_offset.dropna().astype(int)) == list(range(1, len(canonical) + 1))

print(f"\nclient ops = {len(retry)}, canonical entries = {len(canonical)}, "
      f"distinct offsets = {len(set(fmap.final_offset.dropna()))}")
print(f"op<->offset bijective and contiguous 1..{len(canonical)} : {bijective and contiguous}")
print(f"total attempts = {len(att)}, retries = {int(retry.retried.sum())}, "
      f"dedup suppressions = {int(att.dedup.sum())}")
print(f"messages sent = {len(msg)} | DELIVERED = {int(msg.status.eq('DELIVERED').sum())}, "
      f"DELAYED = {int(msg.status.eq('DELAYED').sum())}, DROPPED = {int(msg.status.eq('DROPPED').sum())}")
print(f"offset rewinds (truncations) = {int(offrec.rewound_entries.sum())}, "
      f"duplicate offsets created = {len(canonical) - len(set(fmap.final_offset.dropna()))}")
```
